# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety vs. DOC_posting_ten_five

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | Resume evidence | Match |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | ✅ |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | ✅ |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | ✅ |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | ✅ |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | ✅ |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | ✅ |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | ✅ |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Infrastructure: all five listed | ✅ |
| 9 | Kafka | Streaming: Kafka | ✅ |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not present | ❌ |

## Mandatory Match Percentage

**90% (9 of 10 numbered requirements).**

Item 8 bundles five tools under one number. If each tool is counted separately, there are 14 mandatory items. The candidate meets 13 of them, which is **92.9%**. The result clears the threshold under either method, so the counting choice doesn't change the outcome.

## Decision

**Proceed.** The mandatory match is at least 90%, above the 85% threshold.

## Notes

- **Only gap:** GraphQL. This could be a follow-up question at interview, since REST API experience often transfers.
- **Nice-to-have (no effect on the outcome, per instructions):** The resume shows none of items 11–15 (Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, public speaking). The resume appears to list only technical skills, so the soft skills may exist but not be documented.
